items.title: What happens to passengers’ belongings after a road accident?
items.blurb: Families repeatedly complain about missing cash, jewellery, and phones after crashes, exposing shortcomings in how victims’ possessions are collected, documented, and returned.

items.title: Government plans floodlit home grounds for all eight NPL clubs
items.blurb: Prime Minister Balendra Shah announces stadium construction plans as part of preparations to introduce a home-and-away format from the league’s sixth edition.

items.title: Why Nepal must separate crypto from the future of banking
items.blurb: Disaster relief that began as cryptocurrency has exposed a policy blind spot. Nepal must tell crypto assets, tokenised money and payment rails apart.

items.title: As e-bike battery fires mount, New York weighs tougher restrictions
items.blurb: The deaths of 10 people in two recent New York ​fires prompted the New York City Council to hold ‌an emergency hearing on Friday on a raft of stricter rules for e-bike storage and battery safety.

items.title: Nepse loses ground as trading slows and investors favour select stocks
items.blurb: Banking and selected hydropower stocks show relative strength, but falling daily turnover and weak economic growth prospects limit the market’s recovery.

items.title: Nepal has failed disaster survivors before. Can Bhotekoshi be different?
items.blurb: Past relocation schemes have left families in unsafe settlements or driven them home. A 55-year-old settlement in Kanchanpur offers lessons as the government plans to relocate Bhotekoshi flood survivors.
